reservations.note: Continuation of the cassette side drive space; counted once as a drive assembly. Gives 62mm overall head-drive allowance, not a selected motor.

reservations.note: Outer routing reservation. With proposed 3mm walls a 44x28mm bore would remain; dog-hair bridging and pressure loss need testing.

reservations.note: Dirty bin is one moving piece with adjoining vertical filter chamber; both withdraw rearward together. Downward station-emptying door avoids a long evacuation duct.

reservations.note: Axial intake faces left toward filter; tangential outlet faces rear. Rises through an explicit passive core pocket; remains attached to bottom.

reservations.note: Full-height plenum between vertical filter and blower, including isolation valve. Seal face retracts 3mm right before bin/filter maintenance extraction.

reservations.note: Short rear tangential outlet and grille allowance; port adapter and discharge direction require detailing.

reservations.note: Compact stages above right motor; separate from wheel H-bridge. Actual devices and protection unselected.

reservations.label: Flexible edge-brush sweep allowance
reservations.note: 70mm placeholder centered (5,186); rigid drive stays inside body. Feeds a dedicated side inlet below front dirt well, because brush is behind main rollers.

reservations.label: Rear-left edge brush motor / gate bay
reservations.note: Small geared drive and edge-inlet gate linkage unselected. Gate should restrict unused edge inlet to preserve main-head suction.

reservations.label: Rear-left compliant caster allowance
reservations.note: Two drive wheels plus this rear caster define support polygon; front head skids have compliant contact. Measure loaded CG before proving stability.

reservations.label: Front bumper upper lip
reservations.note: Separate lip above roller opening; bumper linkage and detection still to detail.

reservations.label: Rear-left floor sensor allowance
reservations.note: Below drawer floor; low-profile board/aperture unselected.

reservations.label: Rear-right floor sensor allowance
reservations.note: Below rear exhaust and behind blower bay; hardware and field of view unselected.

reservations.label: Front-left floor sensor allowance
reservations.note: In end-support region; coordinate with actual roller end hardware before printing.

reservations.label: Gated edge inlet allowance
reservations.note: Floor inlet into front dirt well, separate from main roller duct. Air split and gating require pickup tests; closes during station emptying.

reservations.label: Downward evacuation door allowance
reservations.note: Station manifold under supported tray; direct dirt-well evacuation avoids a long narrow rear duct. Door closed while cleaning.

reservations.label: Power distribution / regulator strip
reservations.note: Tighter strip reservation; regulator cooling, fusing and cable bends still to select.

reservations.label: Outward camera / near-field bay
reservations.note: Above bottom connector; camera and field of view unselected.

reservations.label: Core left station pickup rail
reservations.note: Rail above battery service path by 1mm nominally. Section thickness is not a load rating.

reservations.label: Bottom floating connector pocket
reservations.note: Combined mating reservation, projection allocation 16mm above vacuum mate. Connector, interlocks and pinout unselected.

reservations.label: Vertical filter holder / upper extension
reservations.note: Moves with bin drawer. Upper portion rises into a dedicated passive core pocket; contains no core electronics.

notes: Owner size limits: maximum 275x275mm rigid body including wheels; maximum180mm total height including LiDAR. Flexible bristles may extend, explicitly confirmed by owner.

Positions and all unspecified component envelopes are provisional. 60 x 8 mm wheel diameter/width are owner-reported; 3 mm axle hole and no hub protrusion are owner-confirmed; selected bolt-on adapter geometry remains unmeasured. No replacement motors or control boards have been ordered.
The 7.25-inch roller pair replaces the long pair in the current compact layout. The original long-pair cassette is324mm wide and does not meet the new limit.

The upright filter, plenum and blower stay attached to the bottom and rise into explicit passive openings in the core. The core is a frame with equipment trays, not a full slab. No air or dirt crosses a module connector.
Compact usable bin target is0.5-0.6L versus0.5-0.75L previously; actual dog-hair capacity and emptying interval remain unmeasured.
Side brush moved behind wheel to feed a separate gated side inlet; airflow sharing and gating must be tested. Do not assume it feeds the front rollers after they have passed.

Main panels target270x270mm as whole prints. The275mm body includes separate bumpers and station pickup pieces. Nominal bed margins do not establish successful large-print adhesion or toolpath clearance.
Reference parts nest inside reservation volumes; volumes and BOM IDs are not additive. Unmodeled fasteners, cables, frame seats, gaskets, tolerances and airflow can still require changes.
Geometry screens do not prove cleaning quality, structure, loaded CG, traction, runtime, automation or whole-assembly lift. Propulsion work stays deferred.

Bottom retention uses three corner zones and one rear bridge zone above the dirt bin; the bin roof clears that zone by3mm. Bridge structure, core seats and rear station release access remain to design; do not route a support post through the drawer sweep.
The owner permits replacement parts when they improve size, weight or performance. Current owned-part references are replaceable; compare complete installed systems before freezing the frame.

Pictured owned ball casters are reserve candidates, not the modeled 20 mm rear support. Owner dimensions are 28 x 45 mm flange and 13 mm overall height, with 3 mm mount height. They exceed the current 20 x 20 mm support bay; load and floor suitability remain unconfirmed.

constraints.height_includes: All installed rigid parts including LiDAR
constraints.interpretation: Owner wrote width and height 275 followed by height 180; interpreted as 275 width/depth and 180 overall height.

printing.note: 270mm panels nominally leave 5mm per bed edge; actual brim/skirt, probing keepouts and flatness must be checked in the printer profile.
